all pass

messages.note: accountNumber = "{group.Code}-{suffix}" (caller's suffix or a generated one); new Account(...), Status = Active, Balance = 0

messages.label: accounts.created event
messages.note: Dropped, not stored, if the bus is off. Retried indefinitely from the outbox if the bus is on but unreachable.

cards.title: Entirely hand-written
items: Account carries no [CrudCreate] constructor — account-number allocation and the floor/currency checks are all handler logic

cards.title: What this can't show
items: The transaction boundary is the one SaveChanges call: entity and outbox row commit together or not at all
